technology_name: Medical Imaging and Implant Design Platform (SRISTI-3D)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Difficulty in visualizing complex anatomical structures for implant planning
description: SRISTI is a software platform for 3D visualization of CT and MRI images and the creation of anatomical models and prosthetic implants. The system supports rapid prototyping workflows and enables visualization of image data from multiple modalities while reducing complexity in medical image interpretation.
applications:
Hospitals and advanced medical imaging centers
Orthopedic, craniofacial, and reconstructive surgery departments
Medical device, implant design, and 3D printing companies
Medical colleges, research institutions, and teaching hospitals
Healthcare technology companies developing digital surgery and personalized implant solutions
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
